liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Ice Castles** (1 other source): Ice Castles segued directly into The Final Alarm [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **Banannas and Blow**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]
- **Learnin To Live**: rare: 5 archived performances [7]
- **Don't Get 2 Close 2 My Fantasy**: back after 69 archived shows (758 days) [7]

## The recordings

- **ween2009-09-06.mc930.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 28 songs; 131 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the wind blowing the sound around hurt the listening experience at the venue, despite the band's strong playing; A few pops and clicks appear in the recording, possibly from a loose cable; nothing major [1][6]
- **ween2009-09-06.mc930.flac24**: source not stated; 28 songs; 131 min [2]. Said about its sound: A few pops and clicks appear in the recording, possibly from a loose cable; nothing major [2]
- **ween2009-09-06.mbho.flac16**: source not stated; 28 songs; 127 min [3]. Said about its sound: Recording doesn't sound especially good because of the windy night at Red Rocks [3]
- **ween2009-09-06.AKG481s**: source not stated; 28 songs; 125 min [4]

## Around the show

- Strong wind at the show scattered the sound, so piano and guitars seemed to come from different directions [6]
- Taper says about twenty teenagers crowded onto the tarp next to him despite plenty of space elsewhere [1]
- Windy night at Red Rocks affected the recording quality [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2009-09-06.mc930.flac16**: source: Beyerdynamic MC930 > Fostex FR2LE (@ 24/48) [1]
- **ween2009-09-06.mc930.flac24**: source: Beyerdynamic MC930 > Fostex FR2LE (@ 24/48) [2]. Also: This is the 24-bit version, which can't be burned to CD; 16-bit and V0 MP3 versions also exist [2]
- **ween2009-09-06.mbho.flac16**: taped by Eric Foelske; source: MBHO 603a>actives>KA100DK(Row 16/split 20') > V3 > R-44 [3]
- **ween2009-09-06.AKG481s**: taped by Chris King; transferred by Chris King; source: AKGS 481s> R44 Oade (Concert Mod) (24/96) [4]
